rules.name: Speaking Time Exceeded
rules.description: Member has exceeded the allocated time limit for the current debate turn.

rules.name: High Noise Level in Chamber
rules.description: Acoustic decibel levels exceeded the safe threshold for orderly debate.

rules.name: Off-Topic Discussion
rules.description: Speech contents deviated significantly from the active parliamentary agenda bill.

rules.name: Heated Debate / High Emotional Agitation
rules.description: Acoustic and NLP sentiment indicates aggressive agitation or unparliamentary tone.

rules.name: Unparliamentary / Offensive Language
rules.description: Expungable, offensive, or derogatory language detected in the live transcript.

rules.name: Simultaneous Speakers / Interruption
rules.description: Multiple microphones/speakers detected concurrently interrupting the active floor.

rules.name: Unauthorized Seat Displacement / Well Rush
rules.description: Computer vision tracking identified member departing allocated seat towards the well.

rules.name: Emergency Button Activation
rules.description: Emergency hardware/software trigger pressed in chamber or console.
